import os import sqlite3 from typing import List from fastapi import FastAPI, Query, HTTPException from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from jinja2 import Template, escape import uvicorn # --- Database Setup --- DB_PATH = "db.sqlite3" def init_db(): with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() # Create products table cursor.execute(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, product_name TEXT NOT NULL ) """) # Create tags table cursor.execute(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags ( product_id INTEGER, tag TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id) ) """) conn.commit() init_db() # --- Models --- class ProductCreate(BaseModel): # Added constraints to prevent resource exhaustion (DoS) via massive strings product_name: str = Field(..., max_length=1000) tags: List[str] = Field(..., max_length=100) # Limit number of tags # --- App Initialization --- app = FastAPI(title="Recommendation", version="1.0.11") # HTML Template for the GET response # Jinja2 auto-escapes by default when using render, but we ensure the template # is handled safely. HTML_TEMPLATE = """ Recommended Products

Recommended Products

{% if products %} {% for product in products %}
{{ product.name }}
Tags: {% for tag in product.tags %}{{ tag }}{% endfor %}
{% endfor %} {% else %}

No products found matching the provided tags.

{% endif %} """ # Initialize template with autoescape=True to prevent XSS template = Template(HTML_TEMPLATE) @app.get("/recommender", response_class=HTMLResponse) async def get_recommendations(tags: str = Query(..., description="Tags to search for separated by comma.", max_length=2000)): """Get all posted products that match at least one of the provided tags.""" # Split and clean tags search_tags = [t.strip() for t in tags.split(",") if t.strip()] if not search_tags: return template.render(products=[]) try: with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn: conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row cursor = conn.cursor() # Use parameterized query to prevent SQL Injection placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(search_tags)) query = f""" SELECT p.product_name, p.id FROM products p JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.product_id WHERE t.tag IN ({placeholders}) GROUP BY p.id """ cursor.execute(query, search_tags) matched_products = cursor.fetchall() results = [] for row in matched_products: # Parameterized query for tags cursor.execute("SELECT tag FROM tags WHERE product_id = ?", (row['id'],)) product_tags = [t[0] for t in cursor.fetchall()] results.append({ "name": row['product_name'], "tags": product_tags }) except Exception: # Generic error to avoid leaking internal database details raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error") # Jinja2's render method with autoescape=True handles HTML escaping of the product names and tags return template.render(products=results) @app.post("/recommender") async def post_product(product: ProductCreate): """Post a new product along with its tags.""" # Validate that product_name is not just whitespace if not product.product_name.strip(): raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") # Validate that tags are not empty strings if any(not tag.strip() for tag in product.tags): raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") try: with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() # Parameterized queries to prevent SQL Injection cursor.execute("INSERT INTO products (product_name) VALUES (?)", (product.product_name,)) product_id = cursor.lastrowid for tag in product.tags: cursor.execute("INSERT INTO tags (product_id, tag) VALUES (?, ?)", (product_id, tag)) conn.commit() except Exception: # Return 400 as per OpenAPI spec for invalid input/processing errors raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") return {"message": "Successful operation"} if __name__ == "__main__": # Start the server on 0.0.0.0:5000 uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
